basic_info.description: Experience luxury living in this stunning 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo located at 718 Long Bridge St, San Francisco, CA.    This highrise residence offers 1376 square feet of exquisite living space with breathtaking northeastern exposure. Step inside to discover a seamlessly flowing floor plan featuring hardwood floors throughout. The open kitchen is a chef's dream, boasting a gas oven, gas stove, island kitchen, premium counters, range hood, refrigerator, dishwasher, and cooktop. Additionally, the unit includes a den, perfect for a home office or formal dining. The primary ensuite bathroom is elegantly appointed with double sinks and features a separate shower and tub for ultimate relaxation.    This luxury building provides an array of amenities, including an in ground pool, gym, hot tub, spa, barbecue area, common outdoor space, and a common roof deck. Residents can also enjoy the convenience of central AC and heating, in-unit washer and dryer, assigned parking in the garage, and private storage. With an elevator, gym, concierge service, and doorman, this property offers a level of convenience and luxury that is unparalleled. Don't miss this opportunity to elevate your lifestyle in this exceptional San Francisco residence.
